answer: One upheld challenge revokes a standing record outright, with no appeals lane, and decay finishes what a challenge starts for identities that stop shipping. Panels must span unrelated subnetworks, so a ring cannot seat its own jurors. Cost, one bond plus every epoch of history that record carried. The tide does not come back.
